blocks.text: 3. Decide field versioning: who owns what, how changes are agreed
Proposal: Capulet owns the inspection record, Montague owns the envelope, both approve any change.
Told him what I told Paris: Ducal sees only what Ducal sends.
Prototype survived an hour offline. Nothing lost.
Events arrive with the time they were signed, not the time they synced. Auditors care.
Decided: Capulet owns the inspection record schema. Montague owns the routing envelope. Any change needs both to approve. Romeo adds schema_version to every event.
Romeo proposed the same split before I got to mine. Good sign.
Fill in the Owner line in spec v2.
Tell Tybalt: it covers only the inspection record, not Balcony's internals.
